title: cherry-pick 的补丁应用模拟：改动一致、提交 id 变化
expected_output:
=== 待摘取的提交 ===
  commit 874765e  fix(api): reject negative input
  相对父提交的改动: ['if (a < 0) return -1;']
  当前 HEAD(main)=9d920a2 内容: ['int a = 1;', 'int b = 2;', 'return a + b;', '// main tail']

=== cherry-pick 结果 ===
  cherry-pick 冲突数: 0
  新的 tree: ['int a = 1;', 'int b = 2;', 'if (a < 0) return -1;', 'return a + b;', '// main tail']
  新 commit 569c31f  fix(api): reject negative input
  改动是否与原提交等价: True
  提交 id 是否不同: True（874765e vs 569c31f）
  原因: commit SHA = sha1(tree + parent + message + author/committer)，parent 变了 => SHA 必变

=== 反例：目标分支已改动同一行 ===
  HEAD(main)=64f80a7 内容: ['int a = 1;', 'int b = 2;', 'return b + a;']
    int a = 1;
    int b = 2;
    <<<<<<< HEAD(m1)
    return b + a;
    =======
    if (a < 0) return -1;
    >>>>>>> c1
  cherry-pick 冲突数: 1  => 需 git add 后 git cherry-pick --continue（或 --abort 放弃）

结论: cherry-pick 是『复制提交』——把某次改动搬到另一条线，原提交不受影响，落点是全新 SHA
code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""cherry-pick <C>：把 C 相对其父的差异，以『C 的父提交』为 base 做一次三方合并打到当前 HEAD。
结果：**文件内容的改动等价**，但 parent/tree 变了，所以提交 SHA 是全新的（复制提交，不是移动）。"""
import difflib
import zlib


def short(tag):
    return "%07x" % (zlib.crc32(tag.encode("utf-8")) & 0xFFFFFFF)


def obj_sha(kind, payload):
    return short(kind + "|" + payload)


class Repo:
    def __init__(self):
        self.snapshots, self.parents, self.msgs = {}, {}, {}

    def commit(self, tree_lines, msg, parents=()):
        tree = obj_sha("tree", "\n".join(tree_lines))
        cid = obj_sha("commit", tree + "|" + ",".join(parents) + "|" + msg + "|author<dev>")
        self.snapshots[cid] = list(tree_lines)
        self.parents[cid] = list(parents)
        self.msgs[cid] = msg
        return cid


def hunks(base, side):
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=base, b=side, autojunk=False)
    return [(i1, i2, side[j1:j2]) for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes() if tag != "equal"]


def merge3(base, ours, theirs, ours_label="HEAD(m1)", theirs_label="c1"):
    """cherry-pick 的内核：base=被摘提交的父、ours=当前 HEAD、theirs=被摘提交。"""
    h = [("ours",) + x for x in hunks(base, ours)] + [("theirs",) + x for x in hunks(base, theirs)]
    h.sort(key=lambda t: (t[1], t[2]))
    out, pos, i, conflicts = [], 0, 0, 0
    while i < len(h):
        j, end = i, h[i][2]
        while j + 1 < len(h) and h[j + 1][1] <= end:
            j += 1
            end = max(end, h[j][2])
        cluster = h[i:j + 1]
        out.extend(base[pos:min(cluster[0][1], len(base))])
        groups = {}
        for c in cluster:
            groups.setdefault(c[0], []).extend(c[3])
        if len(groups) > 1:
            if len(set(tuple(v) for v in groups.values())) == 1:
                out.extend(next(iter(groups.values())))
            else:
                conflicts += 1
                out.append("<<<<<<< " + ours_label)
                out.extend(groups.get("ours", []))
                out.append("=======")
                out.extend(groups.get("theirs", []))
                out.append(">>>>>>> " + theirs_label)
        else:
            for c in cluster:
                out.extend(c[3])
        pos = max(pos, end)
        i = j + 1
    out.extend(base[pos:])
    return out, conflicts


def added_lines(old, new):
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=old, b=new, autojunk=False)
    return [l for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes() if tag != "equal" for l in new[j1:j2]]


r = Repo()
p1 = r.commit(["int a = 1;", "int b = 2;", "return a + b;"], "feat: add add(a,b)")
c1 = r.commit(["int a = 1;", "int b = 2;", "if (a < 0) return -1;", "return a + b;"],
              "fix(api): reject negative input", [p1])
m1 = r.commit(["int a = 1;", "int b = 2;", "return a + b;", "// main tail"], "chore: init main")

print("=== 待摘取的提交 ===")
print("  commit %s  %s" % (c1, r.msgs[c1]))
print("  相对父提交的改动: %s" % added_lines(r.snapshots[p1], r.snapshots[c1]))
print("  当前 HEAD(main)=%s 内容: %s" % (m1, r.snapshots[m1]))
print()

result, conflicts = merge3(r.snapshots[p1], r.snapshots[m1], r.snapshots[c1])
c2 = r.commit(result, r.msgs[c1], [m1])
print("=== cherry-pick 结果 ===")
print("  cherry-pick 冲突数: %d" % conflicts)
print("  新的 tree: %s" % result)
print("  新 commit %s  %s" % (c2, r.msgs[c2]))
print("  改动是否与原提交等价: %s"
      % (added_lines(r.snapshots[p1], r.snapshots[c1]) == added_lines(r.snapshots[m1], result)))
print("  提交 id 是否不同: %s（%s vs %s）" % (c1 != c2, c1, c2))
print("  原因: commit SHA = sha1(tree + parent + message + author/committer)，parent 变了 => SHA 必变")
print()

# ---- 反例：目标行被本地改动过同一区域 => cherry-pick 也会冲突 ----
m2 = r.commit(["int a = 1;", "int b = 2;", "return b + a;"], "refactor: swap operands")
result2, conflicts2 = merge3(r.snapshots[p1], r.snapshots[m2], r.snapshots[c1])
print("=== 反例：目标分支已改动同一行 ===")
print("  HEAD(main)=%s 内容: %s" % (m2, r.snapshots[m2]))
for line in result2:
    print("    " + line)
print("  cherry-pick 冲突数: %d  => 需 git add 后 git cherry-pick --continue（或 --abort 放弃）" % conflicts2)
print()
print("结论: cherry-pick 是『复制提交』——把某次改动搬到另一条线，原提交不受影响，落点是全新 SHA")
